name: uri-permitted-host-exact-multi-san-mixed-invalid
description: permittedSubtrees URI host.example.com (exact host) plus two URI SANs: one matches exactly, the other has host host.example.com but with userinfo/port that must be stripped before matching. The matcher should evaluate both SANs; the second must pass on its stripped host. This case verifies both SANs are evaluated by setting the second to a different host that, even after userinfo/port stripping, falls outside the bare-host permit.
